picProcedureSteps.title: File notification with your national Competent Authority
picProcedureSteps.detail: Prepare and submit the Basel notification document to your country's CA — include waste type, quantities, proposed route, receiving facility permit, and financial guarantee details.

picProcedureSteps.title: CA transmits notification to destination (and transit) CAs
picProcedureSteps.detail: Your national CA forwards the complete notification package to the importing country CA and any transit country CAs within the required timeframe.

picProcedureSteps.title: Destination CA acknowledges receipt
picProcedureSteps.detail: The importing country CA issues a formal acknowledgement of receipt. This starts the consent clock under Article 6(2). Keep a copy — it is part of your compliance record.

picProcedureSteps.title: Written consent (or tacit approval) received
picProcedureSteps.detail: For explicit PIC: the destination CA issues written consent specifying conditions. For OECD tacit consent (C(2001)107): 30 days' silence after acknowledgement = deemed approval.

picProcedureSteps.title: Documentation complete — shipment may proceed
picProcedureSteps.detail: Retain all consent letters with your movement documents. Shipment must begin within the validity period specified in the consent. Movement documents must accompany the waste at all times.
